title: CIRCULAR ON ADVERT JUNE 2025
text:
NATIONAL INSURANCE COMMISSION
HEAD OFFICE: Plot 1239, Ladoke Akintola Boulevard, Garki II, Abuja. P.M.B. 457, Garki Abuja Nigeria
Email: info@naicom.gov.ng, contact@naicom.gov.ng Website: www.naicom.gov.ng :08172047735
CIRCULAR
REF: NAICOM/I&R/CA/2025/64
DATE: 23 June 2025
TO: All Insurance Institutions
SUBJECT: ADVERTISEMENT OF PRODUCTS AND SERVICES WITHOUT APPROVAL OF THE
COMMISSION
1.0 The Commission has observed that some Insurance Institutions are advertising their
products and services, including through social media platforms, without obtaining prior
approval of the Commission.
2.0 Following the need to provide the enabling regulation for the advertisement of products
and services in the insurance sector, the Commission hereby draws attention to the
following requirements:
a) The provision of section 74 of the Insurance Act 2003 which empowers the Commission
to regulate advertisement of different classes, nature or description and in whatever
medium or platform made; and,
b) All insurance related advertisement of product and services placed/aired/or posted on
social media and other platforms without requisite prior approval of the Commission is a
violation of the extant laws and regulation
3.0 Consequently, the Commission hereby issues this circular that all publications by insurance
institutions or persons/other institutions on insurance related matters, services, products,
on any medium or format shall be with prior express approval of the Commission
Accordingly, all Insurance Institutions and other persons are directed to ensure strict compliance
with the requirement of this circular and any identified violation will be sanctioned in
accordance with the provisions of the law.
A. I. Adamu
Director, Innovation & Regulation
For: Commissioner for insurance
